Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: A city imposes a municipal excise tax of $200 per year on commercial photographic studios in the city. It also imposes an excise tax of $100 per year on every itinerant commercial photographer for the privilege of using the streets and sidewalks. A credit is allowed against this latter tax for any excise tax paid to the city by the photographer or his employer in respect to the maintenance of a photographic studio in the city. In an action by a studio located in the city challenging the constitutionality of the $200 per year excise tax, the court will most likely declare the tax

Options: 
A. unconstitutional, as an undue burden on interstate commerce.
B. unconstitutional, as a discriminatory tax on the privilege of doing business within the state.
C. constitutional, as it is within the city's rights to tax local businesses.
D. unconstitutional, as it infringes on the rights of local businesses.
E. constitutional, as it is a fair method of raising municipal revenue.
F. unconstitutional, as it is a form of double taxation.
G. constitutional, as within the powers of the state to tax the instruments of interstate commerce.
H. constitutional, as it is a reasonable exercise of the city's taxing power.
I. unconstitutional, as it unfairly targets a specific profession.
J. constitutional, as a nondiscriminatory license tax.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
